selected_hypothesis: Massive forward-split execution-date drift no-core basket
economic_mechanism: A forward split is a deliberate, board-approved corporate action that historically correlates with management confidence, improved nominal-price accessibility, retail attention and optionability. The event is exchange-public on its execution date, so a next-open entry uses only public facts. The survivorship-free Massive membership keeps issuers that later delisted or were acquired in the sample, which the current-roster warehouse cannot represent, and the split surface itself was materialized only on 2026-07-28 (exp-20260728-003), so this event family has never been consumed by any prior experiment.
falsifier: Reject unless every standard window has at least five selected touches and strictly positive after-cost replacement value, aggregate replacement value is strictly positive, double-cost aggregate stays positive, max single-ticker positive contribution <= 50%, top-five share <= 60%, contribution HHI <= 0.35, and all identity, split-normalization and decision-clock checks pass.
research_pit_caveat: Only execution_date is available, not the announcement date. The decision clock is execution-date New York close with next-session-open entry; a forward split cannot execute before it was publicly announced, so known_at <= decision_time holds by construction. Immutable as-published vendor vintages remain unverified, so the surface stays research_pit and any positive result is a lead with result_ceiling observed_only.
